projects.title: Routine App
projects.subtitle: Smart Academic Routine & Real-Time Schedule Manager
projects.description: A native Android application crafted with Kotlin and Firebase for university students and Class Representatives (CRs) to eliminate timetable confusion with instant, cloud-synced schedules and role-based permissions.
projects.problemStatement: In universities and colleges, class timetables are constantly updated due to rescheduling, room changes, and faculty availability. Traditional communication channels (like messaging groups or static PDFs) create confusion, missed lectures, and wasted time. Routine App provides a synchronized academic schedule where CRs can update timetable entries in real time, and students receive instant updates with zero manual refresh.
features: Dual-Role Access Control (Students vs. CRs with elevated editing privileges)
Cloud-Synced Weekly Timetable with ViewPager2 swipe transitions
Dynamic Chronological Class Sorting with upcoming lecture priority
Detailed Class Cards with Subject, Room number, Teacher tags, and exact duration
Single-Activity Architecture with Jetpack Navigation and Coroutines

screenshots.caption: Routine App — Next-Gen Academic Schedule Manager
Weekly Timetable with day tabs & class cards
CR Management Modal for timetable CRUD operations
User Profile, verified badge, and settings

projects.architecture: MVVM Architecture with Jetpack Navigation Component, ViewBinding, Kotlin Coroutines, and Firebase Realtime Database for sub-second synchronization.
highlights: Sub-second live synchronization via Firebase Realtime listeners
Strict Role-Based Security ensuring only CRs modify class routines
Production-grade Material 3 responsive UI with dark/light theme support

projects.title: Smart Ledger
projects.subtitle: Cloud-Powered Financial Management & Double-Entry Bookkeeping Platform
projects.description: A cross-platform financial operating system and double-entry bookkeeping platform engineered for SMEs, merchants, and contractors with automated financial reporting, customer party ledgers, and audit trails.
projects.problemStatement: Small-to-medium enterprises often rely on fragmented paper ledger books (khatiyan), spreadsheets, or disconnected calculators. This results in cash-flow blindspots, delayed reconciliations, and costly accounting errors. Smart Ledger delivers a unified, real-time financial hub combining daily cashbooks, customer & supplier party ledgers, and GAAP-compliant double-entry accounting.
features: Executive Financial Dashboard with Real-Time KPIs (To Receive, To Pay, Sales, Cash)
Customer & Supplier Party Ledger with credit limits and running balances
Unified Digital Cashbook tracking cash inflows and outflows with multi-channel tags
GAAP-Compliant Double-Entry Engine (Chart of Accounts, Journal Entries, Trial Balance)
Visual Financial Analytics with periodic breakdown and interactive FL Chart graphs
PostgreSQL Database with Row-Level Security (RLS) and transaction integrity

screenshots.caption: Smart Ledger — Executive Financial Operating System
Executive Financial Dashboard with core KPI metrics
Visual Reporting & Income vs Expense analytics
Unified Digital Cashbook with payment tags
Party & Customer Ledger with running credit balances

projects.architecture: Clean Architecture powered by Riverpod 2.6 state management, Supabase PostgreSQL with strict RLS policies, and interactive FL Chart visualization engines.
highlights: Strict Double-Entry verification ensuring Σ Debit = Σ Credit across all transactions
Zero data-loss audit trails with Supabase Row-Level Security
Cross-platform responsive Flutter client for mobile and desktop

projects.title: Exam Rush Hour
projects.subtitle: Dual-Mode Online Examination & Digital Script Evaluation Platform
projects.description: A full-stack examination and grading platform supporting automated instant MCQ assessments and handwritten exam script grading with an in-app digital red pen drawing board for teachers.
projects.problemStatement: Existing exam software either only supports simplistic multiple-choice tests or requires teachers to manually download, print, or edit hundreds of handwritten student math and engineering answer sheets across third-party photo tools. Exam Rush Hour bridges this gap by unifying automated instant MCQ scoring with an interactive in-app digital grading canvas featuring zoom, 90-degree rotation, and red pen markups.
features: Dual-Mode Testing: Automated MCQ testing with instant scoring & written subjective exams
In-App Digital Grading Board with red pen annotation, stroke width, zoom, and rotation
Multi-Page Answer Sheet Upload pipeline with progressive progress and local caching
Persistent countdown exam timer with anti-cheat session recovery
Real-time teacher submission tracking and automatic score aggregation
Supabase Storage integration with automated script export and cloud archival

screenshots.caption: Teacher Interactive Evaluation Canvas with digital red pen annotations
Student MCQ Exam Room with live countdown timer and question navigator

projects.architecture: Flutter client with code-generated Riverpod 2.5, GoRouter declarative routing, CustomPainter / TransformationController vector drawing engine, and Supabase serverless PostgreSQL.
highlights: Proprietary drawing precision engine maintaining vector mark accuracy across image zoom and 90° rotation
Resilient multi-page upload pipeline designed for low-bandwidth student connections
Full-featured role separation between educators and students

research.title: Deep Learning-Driven Leaf Disease Classification in Indoor Plants with YOLOv11: Stable Diffusion Augmentation Approach
research.publicationName: 2025 28th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT 2025)
research.abstract: Proposes an automated deep learning framework for classifying foliar diseases in indoor plants (Money Plant, Snake Plant, and Spider Plant) using the YOLOv11 architecture. To tackle extreme data scarcity in indoor botanical pathology, a novel hybrid data augmentation pipeline was developed combining traditional geometric and photometric transformations (Albumentations) with synthetic realistic image generation using Stable Diffusion v1.5 image-to-image synthesis, achieving notable classification accuracy gains.

research.title: Deep Learning-Based Leaf Diseases Detection in Indoor Ornamental Plants: A Comparative Study of YOLOv8, YOLOv9, and YOLOv11
research.publicationName: 2025 IEEE International Women in Engineering (WIE) Conference on Electrical and Computer Engineering (WIECON-ECE 2025)
research.abstract: A comprehensive comparative study and empirical benchmark evaluating state-of-the-art real-time object detection models—YOLOv8, YOLOv9, and YOLOv11—for detecting and localizing leaf diseases in indoor ornamental plants. Analyzes trade-offs across mean Average Precision (mAP@0.5 and mAP@0.5:0.95), inference speed, parameter efficiency, and edge deployment suitability under variable lighting conditions.
